q.en: What is the Index of Industrial Production (IIP)?
q.as: শিল্প উৎপাদন সূচক (আইআইপি) কি?

q.en: Which agency publishes the IIP in India?

options.en: The Office of the Economic Adviser under DPIIT
The National Statistics Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

explanation.en: The IIP in India is published by the National Statistics Office, NSO, under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.
